_comment: Shared by sdk-python/tests/test_image_builder_parity.py and sdk-typescript/tests/image-builder-parity.test.ts: the same builder renders the same Dockerfile and request in both SDKs. Each "refused" case is a BadRequestError with its message in both SDKs ("tsError" where TypeScript names the argument in camelCase).

cases.name: registry ref with U+001C and U+0085
Dockerfile ending in U+FEFF keeps it
commands with U+001C
cases.dockerfile:
FROM alpine
RUN ls
RUN echo hi

request.dockerfile:
FROM alpine
RUN ls
RUN echo hi

cases.name: packages with U+0085
cases.dockerfile:
FROM python:3.12
RUN python -m pip install 'numpy>=1.26' requests

request.dockerfile:
FROM python:3.12
RUN python -m pip install 'numpy>=1.26' requests

refused.name: env keys that collide after stripping
refused.error: ImageBuilder.env key "A" appears more than once after stripping

refused.name: env a Map (TypeScript) / a non-mapping (Python)
refused.error: ImageBuilder.env takes a name and a value, or a mapping of names to values

refused.name: registry ref with a lone surrogate
refused.error: ImageBuilder.from_registry ref must not contain a lone surrogate
refused.tsError: ImageBuilder.fromRegistry ref must not contain a lone surrogate

refused.name: env value with a lone surrogate
refused.error: ImageBuilder.env value must not contain a lone surrogate
refused.tsError: ImageBuilder.env value must not contain a lone surrogate

refused.name: env key with an equals sign
refused.error: ImageBuilder.env key "A=B" must not contain '=', whitespace or a control character

refused.name: env key with whitespace
refused.error: ImageBuilder.env key "MY VAR" must not contain '=', whitespace or a control character

refused.name: env key with a newline that would add an instruction
refused.error: ImageBuilder.env key "A\nRUN x" must not contain '=', whitespace or a control character

refused.name: env key with NUL
refused.error: ImageBuilder.env key "A\u0000" must not contain '=', whitespace or a control character

refused.name: env key with DEL
refused.error: ImageBuilder.env key "A" must not contain '=', whitespace or a control character

refused.name: env name with an equals sign
refused.error: ImageBuilder.env name "A=B" must not contain '=', whitespace or a control character

refused.name: env name with U+0085 inside
refused.error: ImageBuilder.env name "AB" must not contain '=', whitespace or a control character
